purpose: Machine-readable boundaries for parity, formal verification, and ROUTE rehearsal claims.

authority.structural_validity: accepted CSR input, valid assignments, deterministic seeds, and local contract tests
authority.quality_parity: requires cut, balance, benchmark envelope, and parity reviewer evidence
authority.formal_verification: bounded Kani harnesses, unsafe inventory, Prusti postcondition stubs, documented gaps, and runtime fallbacks
authority.downstream_readiness: requires affected METIS-CORE tests plus ROUTE consumer rehearsal
authority.route_rehearsal: first downstream compile and service-graph fixture gate for foundation changes

pitfall_boundaries.sourceLayer: README claims, optional gpmetis parity, benchmark baselines, ROUTE adoption, and release notes
verification docs, release claims, README badges, customer-facing proof statements, and future paper evidence
public APIs, defaults, validation behavior, errors, deterministic outputs, quality envelopes, dependency adoption, and portfolio snapshots
blockedClaims: release readiness for affected foundation change
consumer compatibility by local tests only
